sources.observation: Colburn Piatigorsky Archives lists a 1976 RCA reissue pairing the Brahms Double Concerto and Saint-Saens Cello Concerto, naming Milstein, Reiner, Piatigorsky and both Robin Hood Dell and RCA Symphony orchestras. This does not say the orchestra names are synonyms; the paired works must remain separate.

Publisher search result identifies Milstein/Piatigorsky's Brahms collaboration with Reiner and Philadelphia Robin Hood Dell Orchestra. Direct page returned403; not retried. No claim to have inspected that full page.

finding: Cached Praga Brahms tracks explicitly declare RCA Victor Symphony Orchestra; the Saint-Saens coupling uses the same orchestra. Historical source corroborates Robin Hood Dell source cast but does not independently bind this Praga track-level discrepancy.
